project_type: Node.js Express + Socket.io real-time CRM application
build_system: npm with no build step - direct node server.js
test_command: node -c server.js (syntax check only, no tests)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to ensure deps. 2. Run node -c server.js to validate syntax. 3. Optionally start server and check HTTP endpoints respond.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node 22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: Single-file HTML pages with inline CSS/JS. No bundler. Express serves static files from public/.
key_patterns: State stored in data/state.json. Socket.io for real-time updates. Admin room broadcasts. Agent state includes break/washroom/meeting timers. Leaderboard rendered client-side from /api/rankings endpoint. TL page has mode toggle between TL monitoring and Agent dialing mode.
directory_structure: Root: server.js (backend), package.json. public/ has index.html (landing), admin/index.html, agent/index.html, tl/index.html. data/ stores state.json. uploads/ for files and photos.
